_note: German order of battle transcribed from photos of the Italy '43 'Campaign Game German Setup and Reinforcements' and 'Bernhard Line German Setup and Reinforcements' cards. a-d-m = attack-defense-movement as printed; sp = boxed stacking value; tr = tank rating (superscript after attack); range = circled ASU range. 'printed' is the exact strength line. Unit-level a/d/m/quality describe the counter's FULL/READY side when either card shows it; otherwise the side shown, with unit-level reduced=true (reduced side only) or fired=true (Fired side only). 'back' = the reduced side when seen. Per-scenario objects: start = hex at start (null if not on map); startBox = eliminated | permanentlyRemoved | remnantDisplay | withdrawn when off map; frozen/garrison from the card frame and corner box; reduced/fired = the side the unit is placed on; arrive = reinforcement turn and entry area; events = release/withdraw/return/remove in card order. corner = number printed top-right on the counter (campaign start hex or arrival turn); cornerBox frozen = blue box, garrison = black box. ASUs are recorded a=0, d=1 (printed 'S (1) 5': S = CRT column shift, parenthesized defense).

Bernhard 'Fortification / No Combat' markers at 2405, 2406, 2508, 2504 (Cassino): read as the reverse 'Under Construction' side of Level 1 forts (18.1.1) - 4 of these + 4 completed 1L = the 8 L1 forts of 18.1.3. Interpretation, not stated on the card.

Bernhard: 26 Pz ASU, I/67, I/9, II/9 and 129/29PG have no at-start position - the card only lists their RETURN (T14 via N3, T19 via N2). Recorded with startBox='withdrawn'.
